name: Tenabris
summary: Eclipse plunges players into a harrowing VR horror experience where darkness conceals unimaginable terrors. As they embody a gorilla caught in a sinister game of survival, players must navigate the labyrinthine corridors of an abandoned research complex, evading the relentless pursuit of nightmarish monstrosities. The creatures, once products of a classified experiment gone awry, stalk the shadows with heightened senses, driven by an insatiable hunger for prey.
